how.title: Get the full picture in two minutes.
how.s2d: Upload a CSV from openrouter.ai/activity, or connect an Admin API key.
how.s3d: See which models and apps cost the most, and where to save.

items.a: OpenRouter (CSV import and API sync), Anthropic and OpenAI (via their Admin Usage APIs). You'll see Gemini, Mistral, Groq or Grok models if you call them through OpenRouter. Direct connections to other providers aren't available yet.

items.q: How do I upload an OpenRouter CSV?
items.a: On openrouter.ai open Activity and choose Export → CSV. Then drop the file onto the dashboard. Re-uploading is fine — duplicates are skipped by request ID.

items.q: How do you convert dollars to crowns?
items.a: Providers bill in USD. Tokeny fetches the official Czech National Bank rate once a day. Switch currency with a single tap.

Data lives in Supabase Postgres and every row is tied to your account with Row-Level Security policies. Provider API keys are stored server-side only and never sent back to the browser. You can delete your account and all data at any time from your profile.
The core dashboard is free. A Pro plan (99 CZK per month or 990 CZK per year) is in the works — with automatic sync, unlimited alerts, cost forecasting and an AI assistant. The free plan stays.
MCP (Model Context Protocol) lets AI clients such as Claude Desktop or Cursor read your stats. Generate a token in Settings, paste it into your client config and ask right in the chat.
